brand_identity.name: pollo.ag
brand_identity.mission: B2B Marketing, Sales, and Process Solutions with an AI-first approach.

gradient.usage: Use as signature (header, highlights) only. NEVER as full background for long text.

grid_structure.bento_mode: Use 'Tetris' grid logic: mix col-span-full, col-span-6, and col-span-4 for visual interest. Avoid uniform grids.

buttons.primary: bg-[#CA6E23] text-[#160907] font-semibold rounded-lg px-8 py-4 hover:brightness-110 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(202,110,35,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: border border-[#3A231D] bg-transparent text-[#FAF7F4] hover:bg-[#3A231D]/30 transition-all duration-300 rounded-lg px-6 py-3

cards.style: bg-[#1E0D0A]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#3A231D] rounded-xl hover:border-[#CA6E23]/50 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: bg-[#0F0504] border border-[#3A231D] text-[#FAF7F4] placeholder:text-[#B9ABA4] rounded-md focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CA6E23] focus:border-[#CA6E23] transition-all

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#160907]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#3A231D]

visual_enhancers.gradients: Use the official gradient for text clips (bg-clip-text text-transparent) on key words or decorative lines.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders with low opacity (#3A231D) to define structure without heaviness.

preferences.scroll_reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
preferences.parallax: Use useScroll and useTransform for subtle background movement in Hero and Method sections.

hero_background.alt: Abstract flowing light lines on dark background
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy overlay (opacity-80 #160907) to ensure text readability.

solutions_abstract.usage: Background or visual element for Solutions Hub.

tech_overlay.usage: Subtle overlay for 'Performance' and 'SEO' landing pages.

admin_panel.layout: Sidebar navigation (left), Top bar (user info), Main content area (right).
admin_panel.style: High density, clear data tables, less decorative than marketing pages.

implementation_rules.charts: Recharts (already installed) for KPI count-ups and analytics visuals.
critical: DO NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Sora' (import from Google Fonts).
Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards on the dark background.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use transparent backgrounds without a blur or scrim.
